content.title: 过去完成时及其被动语态(had done / had been done)速查
content.intro: 过去完成时表示「过去的过去」:在某个过去时间点之前已经完成或已持续的动作。构成 had + 过去分词(主动 had done;被动 had been done)。判断口诀:两个过去动作,先发生的那个用过去完成。

rows: 过去某点前已完成:When the doctor arrived, the man had stopped breathing.
主语承受动作:The wound had been cleaned before she bandaged it.
先发生→had done;后发生→did:By the time help came, he had given first aid.
No sooner had…than… / Hardly had…when…:刚一……就……

specialRules.rule: 两个过去动作,先发生的用过去完成,后发生的用一般过去
specialRules.mark: She had cleaned the wound before she covered it.

specialRules.rule: 被动语态:had + been + 过去分词
specialRules.mark: The victim had already been taken to hospital.

specialRules.rule: 常见时间标志:by + 过去时间 / by the time / before / after / already
specialRules.mark: By 2010, she had worked there for ten years.

specialRules.rule: No sooner / Hardly 置于句首要部分倒装
specialRules.mark: No sooner had he swallowed it than he began to choke.

why: 过去完成时是为了把两个过去动作分出先后:用 had done 把更早的动作'推'到更远的过去,听者一下就知道哪件事先发生。被动时主语不是动作的执行者,就把 had done 变成 had been done。
gaokaoPoints: by the time / before / after 引导的句子里时态前后呼应(过去完成 vs 一般过去),语法填空与改错高频。
No sooner had…than… 和 Hardly had…when… 的倒装与连词搭配(than 配 No sooner,when 配 Hardly),不可混用。
被动判断:看主语是否承受动作,是则用 had been done。

examVsReal.exam: When I arrived, he had already left.（考试严格区分先后）
examVsReal.real: When I arrived, he already left.（口语有时也用一般过去）
examVsReal.note: 考试看到'过去的过去'必须用过去完成;日常口语里如先后很清楚,母语者偶尔用一般过去

examVsReal.exam: No sooner had she sat down than the phone rang.（书面/考试倒装）
examVsReal.real: She had just sat down when the phone rang.（口语更常这样说）
examVsReal.note: 倒装结构正式、考试爱考;口语里人们更爱用 just…when 表达同样意思
